d:
Geeta Sachan, the accused in the Kanpur Thar accident case that claimed the life of LIC agent Santosh Singh Chauhan, has presented her version of the incident. She claims potholes and poor street lighting caused the accident, and that she accidentally pressed the accelerator instead of the brake while trying to save the victim. Meanwhile, Kanpur Police is gathering fresh evidence and preparing to approach the court again.
Production: Akankshya Gogoi
Video Editor: Ved Prakash
